title: TC Industries
description: tcindustries.com Revenue $242.9 Million TC Industries is a family owned industrial company founded in 1881, headquartered in Crystal Lake, Illinois, owned by the Berry family since 1935 and run by Bob and George Berry with the fourth generation Bert and Sterling Berry preparing to lead. It is the leading North American maker of cutting edges, wear parts and ground engaging tools for construction, mining and earth moving equipment, and the premier commercial heat treating provider in the region. Key customers are OEM giants Caterpillar, Volvo and Komatsu, and it is the largest independent producer of heat treated cutting edges in the US, Canada and Europe. Four plants in Crystal Lake, Guelph Ontario, Selkirk Manitoba and Skinningrove England employ over 500 people. The one stop shop covers cutting, CNC machining, heat treating, welding, carbide strips, painting and packaging, backed by ISO 9001, 14001 and 17025 certified quality.
